title: Port the wide-screen layout from hard-decisions.anth.us: 88% column from 2000px, two-column sections and one-row hero from 2400px

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Wide layout ported on branch feat/wide-layout (commit 2bcea90, not pushed or merged).

What changed: site.css wide block replaced (1500px: --max 1320px and a 36em text measure; 2000px: zoom 1.25 and --max 88%; 2800/4000px: zoom 1.4/1.6; 2400px: sec-split/sec-prose two-column sections with a sticky head, sec-panel split inside the regulated banner and risk panel, one-row home hero, caveat cards 6 across). Sections marked by scripts/split-sections.py plus hand edits (Board, RiskPanel, home banner, one-line sections). New test/layout.test.mjs.

Measured (dev server, same-origin iframes; home, /engines/laya/, /gender/, /nationality/, /methods/):
- 375-1440px: element-by-element layout identical before and after on 10 pages (home and methods compared with chart internals excluded, as the original itself varies between loads there).
- 1920px: column 0.688 of the window, one column. 2560/3440/3840/5120px: column 0.88, sections two columns, home hero one row, dim grid 4/5/6/7 columns, caveats 6.
- Longest prose line at 1920px and up: 80 characters or fewer, apart from dense hash or checkpoint ids. No horizontal overflow at any width, apart from an existing one at 375-1280px on model pages (.ci-t), which is unchanged.
- Tooltips under zoom 1.25/1.4/1.6: centred within 0.8px of their mark, gap within 1.5px (hero marks, board/forest marks, spider vertices).
- Dark mode: tokens apply.
- npm run build: 1114 pages, legacy redirects written. npm test: 45/45 pass.

Found: spider charts throw 'size is not a function' (charts.js spider() local const size shadows the util import), so every spider chart is blank. This was already on main and is not fixed here.

right_now_summary: The wide layout is ported on a local branch and tested; spider charts still fail due to an existing bug.
